name: Cliniko vs Jane App
title: Cliniko vs Jane App: Allied Health Practice Management Comparison
description: Compare Cliniko and Jane App - two leading practice management platforms for allied health. See differences in pricing, features, telehealth, and billing.

summary.bottom_line: Both Cliniko and Jane App are excellent practice management platforms for allied health practices. Cliniko offers simpler flat-rate pricing with all features included and free data migration. Jane App provides more advanced features including built-in telehealth, AI Scribe, and stronger North American billing support. Choose Cliniko for simplicity and global use; choose Jane App for telehealth-heavy practices needing AI documentation.

sections.heading: Cliniko vs Jane App: Overview
sections.content: Cliniko and Jane App are both popular practice management platforms designed for allied health practitioners. Cliniko was founded in Australia and is popular globally with a strong presence in Australia, UK, and Europe. Jane App was founded in Canada and has a strong presence in North America. Both platforms serve multi-disciplinary practices including physiotherapy, chiropractic, massage therapy, and psychology. The key differences lie in telehealth capabilities, AI features, and regional billing support.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Cliniko uses flat pricing where all features are included at every tier—you only pay more as you add practitioners ($45/month solo to $395/month for large practices). Jane App uses feature-tiered pricing: Balance ($54/mo) limits appointments, Practice ($79/mo) includes unlimited, and Thrive ($99/mo) adds advanced features. Jane's add-ons include AI Scribe ($15/mo), Insurance Billing ($20/mo), and custom websites ($59/mo). For a practice wanting all features, Jane App typically costs more but includes telehealth and AI.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: The biggest differentiator is telehealth: Jane App includes HIPAA-compliant telehealth while Cliniko does not. Jane App also offers an AI Scribe for documentation assistance. For billing, Jane App has stronger North American support including Canadian Telus Health integration and US insurance billing add-on. Cliniko's strength is simplicity—no feature gates, free data migration, and stable pricing since 2011. Both have excellent online booking, scheduling, and clinical notes.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your telehealth needs and location:

recommendations.when: You want simple all-inclusive pricing, don't need built-in telehealth, prefer free data migration, or practice outside North America
You need built-in telehealth, want AI documentation assistance, are a Canadian practice needing Telus billing, or prefer a North American platform
You're a multi-disciplinary allied health practice with primarily self-pay clients and flexible on telehealth platform

faqs.q: Does Cliniko have telehealth like Jane App?
faqs.a: No, Cliniko does not include native telehealth. You would need a separate platform like Doxy.me or Zoom. Jane App includes HIPAA-compliant telehealth on all plans with Group Telehealth as a $15/mo add-on.

faqs.q: Which is better for Canadian practices?
faqs.a: Jane App has stronger Canadian billing support with Telus Health integration for direct insurance billing. Jane is also headquartered in Canada and complies with PIPEDA and PHIPA. Cliniko works for Canadian practices but doesn't have the same depth of Canadian billing integration.

faqs.q: Does Jane App have AI features like Cliniko?
faqs.a: Jane App has AI features; Cliniko does not. Jane's AI Scribe ($15/mo per practitioner) helps turn sessions into documentation. Cliniko does not currently offer AI documentation assistance.

Jane App is known for exceptional customer service, winning a 2026 Silver Stevie Award for support. Cliniko also has good support but operates from Australia, which may affect response times for North American users.
